launch_notes: Delivery is the pilot 3 protocol. For each run launch one Agent call with subagent_type general-purpose, model = agent_model ('sonnet' or 'haiku'), no isolation, and as its prompt the run's `launch_prompt` exactly. The agent reads its packet itself; the runner pastes nothing else into the prompt.

Order: 'runs' is already in launch order (shuffled with a fixed seed, so models, arms and repeats are interleaved). Take the runs with round = 1, then round = 2, and so on; 30 runs per round, 60 rounds. The runs of a round may go in parallel (mind the concurrency limit: a launch the limit refuses is relaunched, with the same packet, because the counter is still at zero).

Before the first round: 'python code/build_full_plan.py frozen' and 'python code/build_agent_packets.py check-plan --plan full' clean, then 'python code/lock_answers.py lock --extended --with-code' (the lock procedure of the pilots), then 'status --require-locked'. data/requests/ is locked during the runs although every packet carries the text of its own request; each agent is told to read only its packet and its stage folder, and the transcript lane check afterwards verifies that it did.

Each run's final message is saved, exactly as received, to data/agent_runs/scratch/full/final-<run_id>.txt, and one line {"run_id", "tokens", "tool_calls", "duration_s"} is appended to data/agent_runs/scratch/full/usage-round-NN.jsonl (NN = the round, two digits).

A run that fails before answering is not edited in place: its counter is kept as an earlier attempt and a fresh one registered with 'build_agent_packets.py packet --request REQ-Txx --arm A --model M --repeat N --set full --new-attempt' (this needs the code and the request folder, so it can only be done after the unlock, or with the run left for a later round).
Unlock only after the last round, then collect each run with code/collect_agent_answer.py, lane-check the transcripts and mark.

Query budget raised to 30 (15 Oct 2026, after round 38). Rounds 39 to 60 run at 30 queries as planned. The runs of rounds 1 to 38 that had used all 12 queries were set aside (data/agent_runs/superseded_cap12/) and are run again, under 30, with the same run ids, in rounds 61 onwards (30 to a round, shuffled with seed [42, 12]). The packet's launch_prompt is unchanged.
